acceptance: An agent of cycle N cannot write in .evolve/runs/cycle-M
The contract gap row is a deny row
Every phase still writes its own run artifacts
fix: Resolve the grant to the dispatch own cycle directory only: a {cycle} template in the profile, or the resolver substitutes the running cycle. Then flip the gap row to deny. Check every phase that writes into its own run dir.
summary: Found by the sandbox contract lane, 2026-10-11. About 90 agent profiles declare .evolve/runs/cycle-* in sandbox.write_subpaths. resolveSandboxWriteGrants widens that path to .evolve/runs, so an agent can write in any cycle run directory (cycle isolation is broken). The agent-messaging design (ADR-0129 D3, the outbox identity by location) depends on this isolation. The contract test has a gap row that asserts the write is allowed today and that flips when the gap closes.
title: A sandboxed agent can write in another cycle run directory
